+def _component_08(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 1 << index for index, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    source = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bits.get(source, 0)
+    initial_state = (source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])
+    best = {initial_state: data["start"]}
+    queue = [(data["start"], source, initial_mask, data["coupons"])]
+
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, coupons = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, coupons)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            departure = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if departure >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            transitions = [(edge["duration"], coupons)]
+            if coupons:
+                discounted = max(1, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                transitions.append((discounted, coupons - 1))
+            for duration, remaining in transitions:
+                arrival = departure + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_node = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bits.get(next_node, 0)
+                next_state = (next_node, next_mask, remaining)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
